question: Which sport is played by the Indian sportsperson Sandeep Kumar?
solution:
The correct answer is__** **____**Archery.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sandeep Kumar is an Indian archer.
 
• He competed in the men's compound archery team event.
 
• He won the gold medal at the 2014 Asian Games in Incheon, South Korea.
 
• He was awarded the prestigious Arjuna Award in 2015.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Archery Championship**

 
 
• **​Organized By**: Archery Association of India (AAI)
 
• **Details**: The National Archery Championship is the most prestigious domestic competition in India. It includes both recurve and compound divisions and is conducted annually with participants from all over the country.
 
• **Objective**: It helps identify top archers who can represent India at international levels such as the Olympics, Asian Games, and World Championships.
